title: Replace `facetName` by a facet object

comments.body:
> I'd like to replace the facetName prop by a facet prop, with a name attribute but possibly other ones.

If your question comes from the fact that you are going to need to ask for a facetName <=> facetLabel/Title mapping in the upcoming clear-refinements proposal then I would say thats not a need we need to fill.

That's not a problem if one widget is asking for the facetName <=> facetLabel/Title mapping.
I just referenced the new issue to explain what I was asking this for.
As you want, it was for consistency across widgets, but if it's not  an issue, yes we can definitely close it.
